episodes.overview: The stakes are raised when a discovery is made that will send shockwaves far and wide.

episodes.name: Saul Gone
episodes.overview: The series finale.

name: Peaky Blinders
overview: A gangster family epic set in 1919 Birmingham, England and centered on a gang who sew razor blades in the peaks of their caps, and their fierce boss Tommy Shelby, who means to move up in the world.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Birmingham, 1919. Thomas Shelby controls the Peaky Blinders, one of the city's most feared criminal organisations, but his ambitions go beyond running the streets.When a crate of guns goes missing, Thomas recognises an opportunity to move up in the world.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Birmingham, 1919. Thomas Shelby controls the Peaky Blinders, one of the city's most feared criminal organisations, but his ambitions go beyond running the streets.Thomas fixes a horserace, provoking the ire of local kingpin Billy Kimber. He also starts a war with gypsy family the Lees. Meanwhile, Inspector Campbell carries out a vicious raid of Small Heath in search of the stolen guns.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Thomas Shelby plans to go to Cheltenham races in order to get closer to Billy Kimber. Knowing the gangster's appetite for beautiful women, Thomas invites Grace to accompany him.Meanwhile some IRA sympathisers approach Thomas with an offer to buy the stolen guns.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Thomas Shelby's war with the Lee family of gypsies escalates and Campbell puts further pressure on him to deliver the stolen guns. Meanwhile, Thomas's brother John plans to marry a former prostitute, but Thomas suspects that she's still on the game.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Thomas Shelby has to deal with an IRA chief who has come to Small Heath to avenge his cousin's death. Meanwhile, Campbell gets closer to the stolen guns, and Grace has to decide whether her loyalties lie with him or with Thomas.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: As Thomas Shelby prepares to oust Billy Kimber, hidden secrets are revealed and the family have to face up to the problems that have divided them. Meanwhile, Campbell, obsessed with taking down the Peaky Blinders, unleashes one last plan to destroy them.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: As the 1920s begin to roar, business is booming for the Peaky Blinders gang. Tommy Shelby starts to expand his legal and illegal operations, with an eye on the racetracks of the south. Meanwhile, an enemy from Tommy's past returns to Birmingham.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Tommy offers to help Polly by searching for her children, who long ago were taken from her. In London, Tommy risks his life by meeting enigmatic leader Alfie Solomons. Meanwhile Arthur continues to feel the devastating effects of the Great War.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Tommy hatches a plan to take control of the southern racecourses. He also meets the aristocratic May Carleton and sees an opportunity to move up in the world. Meanwhile both Major Campbell and London gangster Darby Sabini plan Tommy's downfall.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Tommy finds out exactly what mission Major Campbell is forcing him to undertake. Arthur spearheads a ferocious takeover of London's Eden Club. Meanwhile, Polly's son Michael is welcomed into the business and quickly experiences the dark side of the Peaky Blinders.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Tommy is caught by surprise when his powerbase in London is obliterated. As Tommy struggles to save his family and regain the upper hand, May expresses her feelings for him, and he is paid a visit by an old friend.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: As derby day arrives, Tommy is faced with impossible decisions as he plans to strike back at his enemies and take the family business to another level. Meanwhile, Major Campbell has one final card to play - one that he is certain will bring about Tommy's demise.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: It is Thomas Shelby's long-awaited wedding day. In the middle of the celebrations, a mysterious visitor imperils the entire Shelby family, and Tommy finds himself pulled into a web of intrigue more lethal than anything he has yet encountered.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Tommy discovers the extent of the mission given to him and the extreme lengths his new paymasters are willing to go to in their quest for power.Meanwhile his own family's activities lead to escalating danger in Birmingham.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Responding to the Italians' actions, Tommy is set on a path of deadly vengeance. Meanwhile, as he makes plans for his mission on behalf of the Russians, he realises there is a traitor in his midst.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Tommy and Tatiana play a personal and dangerous game to acquire information from one another, and Tommy finally comprehends the magnitude of Tatiana's warped ideals.Meanwhile, Polly reveals a dark secret, with terrible consequences for Tommy.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: As the Russians test the Peaky Blinders, Tommy realises that he is being seriously outmanoeuvred. But he has an ace up his sleeve in the form of an enemy turned ally - if only he can control him.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: As Tommy prepares to commit the most audacious crime of his career, a blow is struck against him that could change everything. As he faces his worst fears, he needs his family more than ever - but who can he trust?

episodes.name: The Noose
episodes.overview: December 1925. Tommy Shelby OBE has acquired unprecedented legitimacy. The former gangster is also a man alone, estranged from his family and focused only on business. But when he receives a mysterious letter on Christmas Eve, Tommy realises that the Shelbys are in danger of annihilation. As the enemy closes in, Tommy flees his country house and returns to the only safe place he knows: Small Heath, Birmingham, the slum where he grew up. Facing a more determined and sophisticated threat than ever before, the Shelby family must find a way to put differences aside, work together, take up arms and fight for survival...

episodes.name: Heathens
episodes.overview: As the Shelbys come to terms with the shocking events of Christmas Day, Tommy endeavours to unite his family. Until the current threat is dealt with, their only safe place is together in Small Heath. Johnny Dogs and Charlie set about arming the locals - everyone is now a Peaky bodyguard. Tommy enlists the help of tough Romany Gypsy Aberama Gold, who wants something unusual in return.Jessie Eden confronts Tommy about the workers' pay. She warns him that revolution is in the air, and when Tommy doesn't relent she calls his bluff. As the situation plays out, Tommy's factory manager tells him he has one more meeting - with a mysterious businessman from Paris. But what transpires is no ordinary meeting with no ordinary businessman...

episodes.name: Blackbird
episodes.overview: The Italians launch another attack on the Peaky Blinders. Tommy realises that the Shelbys need to evolve if they are to survive, but some of the family are reluctant to part with tradition.As the strike takes hold at the Lanchester factory, Tommy pays a personal visit to Jessie Eden, but he is outmanoeuvred when she reveals something she knows about his past.Changretta plots to continue the vendetta in the most devastating way possible. As well as identifying an enemy of the Shelby family who could help him, Luca makes direct contact with someone at the heart of the Peaky Blinders organisation.

episodes.name: Dangerous
episodes.overview: The Peaky Blinders are lured by the Italians into a cat-and-mouse chase on the streets of Birmingham, where it becomes clear that Tommy has met his match. Trapped in Small Heath, Tommy tries to console himself with a visit from an old flame but it soon becomes clear that he can't always get what he wants.As his factory lies idle, Tommy confronts the possibility that the Communists might win and he will be deemed a traitor to his class. Meanwhile, Changretta prepares to spring another trap.

episodes.name: The Duel
episodes.overview: Tommy prepares himself as the bloody battle lines are drawn between the Peaky Blinders and Changretta. A deal is struck - with potentially devastating consequences.

episodes.name: The Company
episodes.overview: It is the night of the big fight - Bonnie Gold versus Goliath. But as the bell rings and the crowd goes wild, dangers lurk in the shadows for Tommy Shelby and his family. When Changretta plays his final ace, he sets in motion a series of events that will change the Peaky Blinders forever.

episodes.name: Black Tuesday
episodes.overview: 1929 – The Shelby family have dispersed: Michael is living at Shelby Company headquarters in Detroit, while Aunt Polly is holed up with a pilot in Monte Carlo. But the family are quickly brought back together when news of the Wall Street Crash hits and its implications for the family business become clear.Meanwhile, Tommy's political career is going from strength to strength; he gives a rousing speech in the House of Commons. It's not long, however, before ghosts from Tommy's past threaten to undermine his position.

episodes.name: Black Cats
episodes.overview: Tommy is at Arrow House when he receives a call from a mysterious new ally with potentially devastating information. At Westminster, in a dimly lit bar, he, Ada and Mosley meet to discuss business.Meanwhile, a rival gang, keen to send a message to Tommy, use brutal means to do so. At the Garrison pub, Arthur and Finn reveal their plans to expand the Peaky business empire. Later, a birthday celebration is interrupted by the unexpected arrival of someone close to Tommy with a message about a dangerous new enemy.

episodes.name: Strategy
episodes.overview: Tommy gathers everyone together to discuss recent tragic events and to give his orders, before the Shelby men travel to London to meet Mosley and it's soon revealed who has the upper hand. Linda heads to Arrow House to ask Lizzie's advice, Polly visits Aberama to pass on instructions from Tommy, who learns that one of the Peaky Blinders is in danger and sends Arthur and Johnny Dogs on an urgent mission to intervene.

episodes.name: The Loop
episodes.overview: Tommy waits by the water at Charlie's Yard to meet a dangerous adversary. Despite their past grievances, the pair agree to a truce. Later, in a private room at the Garrison pub, as Tommy meets with his constituents to hear their grievances, a mysterious stranger with a message arrives. At his Westminster office, Tommy makes Aberama an offer he can't refuse before inviting Mosley to a party he is throwing for Lizzie's birthday. On the night of the party, things soon take a turn for the worse when a surprise guest arrives.

episodes.name: The Shock
episodes.overview: Mosley takes advantage of shocking events to give a speech to the gathered crowd at Arrow House. Afterwards, Mosley gives Tommy his instructions. Arthur and his men arrive at Limehouse for the arranged rendezvous, but the situation has changed drastically. Meanwhile, Tommy visits an old war comrade who has a very specific skill that Tommy intends to use.

episodes.name: Mr Jones
episodes.overview: News of Tommy's activities have reached Winston Churchill. At a family meeting, Tommy lays out his plans for Mosley, which will take place at a rally Sir Oswald is leading. Tommy is surprised by another strategy, coming from an unexpected corner. Meanwhile, Tommy has his own secrets to reveal.

episodes.name: Black Day
episodes.overview: Tommy sets off to North America, where the end of Prohibition brings new opportunities. But he faces new danger from an old adversary who is finally making his move.

episodes.name: Black Shirt
episodes.overview: Tommy gets involved in a power game with fascists, freedom fighters and Boston gangsters. As the players plan to double cross him, Tommy visits an old ally in Camden.

episodes.name: Gold
episodes.overview: As Ruby is rushed into hospital for urgent treatment for consumption, Tommy is more convinced than ever that his family has been cursed. He sets out on a journey to a gypsy camp to discover who is responsible and how his family might be saved. Ada takes charge of the situation, instructing Arthur to round up some new recruits and head to Liverpool to deliver a warning.

episodes.name: Sapphire
episodes.overview: Tommy establishes a connection between crime and political power that could alter the course of history. He also receives life-changing news from an unexpected source.

episodes.name: The Road to Hell
episodes.overview: In the light of extraordinary personal revelations, Tommy takes a course of action that will change everything. Meanwhile, his enemies' plans start to fall into place.

episodes.name: Lock and Key
episodes.overview: A war veteran who fought in the trenches, Tommy Shelby has been a gangster, an entrepreneur, a captain of industry, a spy and ultimately a Member of Parliament. In the course of this odyssey, he has taken on numerous criminal organisations, business adversaries, foreign insurgents, and the British Establishment itself.Now, in the 1930s, as the clouds of the coming storm gather, he faces the consequences of his experiences and his actions.

name: The Last of Us
overview: Twenty years after modern civilization has been destroyed, Joel, a hardened survivor, is hired to smuggle Ellie, a 14-year-old girl, out of an oppressive quarantine zone. What starts as a small job soon becomes a brutal, heartbreaking journey, as they both must traverse the United States and depend on each other for survival.

episodes.name: When You're Lost in the Darkness
episodes.overview: Twenty years after a fungal outbreak ravages the planet, survivors Joel and Tess are tasked with a mission that could change everything.

episodes.name: Infected
episodes.overview: After escaping the QZ, Joel and Tess clash over Ellie's fate while navigating the ruins of a long-abandoned Boston.

episodes.name: Long, Long Time
episodes.overview: When a stranger approaches his compound, survivalist Bill forges an unlikely connection. Later, Joel and Ellie seek Bill's guidance.

episodes.name: Please Hold to My Hand
episodes.overview: After abandoning their truck in Kansas City, Joel and Ellie attempt to escape without drawing the attention of a vindictive rebel leader.

episodes.name: Endure and Survive
episodes.overview: While attempting to evade the rebels, Joel and Ellie cross paths with the most wanted man in Kansas City. Kathleen continues her hunt.

episodes.name: Kin
episodes.overview: After ignoring the advice of locals, Joel and Ellie descend deeper into dangerous territory in search of the Fireflies – and Tommy.

episodes.name: Left Behind
episodes.overview: As Joel fights to survive, Ellie looks back on the night that changed everything.

episodes.name: When We Are in Need
episodes.overview: Ellie crosses paths with a vengeful group of survivors – and draws the attention of its leader. A weakened Joel faces a new threat.

episodes.name: Look for the Light
episodes.overview: A pregnant Anna places her trust in a lifelong friend. Later, Joel and Ellie near the end of their journey.

episodes.name: Future Days
episodes.overview: Five years after the events in Salt Lake City, a now 19-year-old Ellie makes a discovery while on patrol with her best friend Dina. Back in Jackson Hole, Joel seeks help to mend his relationship with Ellie.

episodes.name: Through the Valley
episodes.overview: As a storm brews in the mountains, the people of Jackson Hole prepare for the worst amid increased sightings of Infected. Meanwhile, Abby weighs her options.

episodes.name: The Path
episodes.overview: After Dina shares crucial information, Ellie prepares to petition the town council, even while she struggles with her deep emotional scars. On the outskirts of Seattle, a religious sect attempts to flee a war – raising questions on what lies ahead.

episodes.name: Day One
episodes.overview: In 2018, Seattle FEDRA confronts an unexpected foe. Ten years later, Ellie and Dina find themselves in the middle of a bloody battle between the zealous Seraphites and a ruthless militia.

episodes.name: Feel Her Love
episodes.overview: The WLF makes a dangerous discovery... at a great cost. Later, Ellie must decide whether to continue with her plan – and risk putting Dina in danger – or give up on her quest for justice.

episodes.name: The Price
episodes.overview: Joel surprises Ellie for her birthday. As their rift continues to widen, Ellie prepares for a confrontation, while Joel makes a difficult choice out on patrol.

episodes.name: Convergence
episodes.overview: As the Wolves and the Scars prepare for a battle that could potentially end their longstanding feud, Ellie's search draws her away from her friends and toward a devastating confrontation.

name: House of the Dragon
overview: The Targaryen dynasty is at the absolute apex of its power, with more than 15 dragons under their yoke. Most empires crumble from such heights. In the case of the Targaryens, their slow fall begins when King Viserys breaks with a century of tradition by naming his daughter Rhaenyra heir to the Iron Throne. But when Viserys later fathers a son, the court is shocked when Rhaenyra retains her status as his heir, and seeds of division sow friction across the realm.

episodes.name: The Heirs of the Dragon
episodes.overview: Viserys hosts a tournament to celebrate the birth of his second child. Rhaenyra welcomes her uncle Daemon back to the Red Keep.

episodes.name: The Rogue Prince
episodes.overview: Six months later. Rhaenyra oversteps at the Small Council. Viserys is urged to secure the succession through marriage. Daemon announces his intentions.

episodes.name: Second of His Name
episodes.overview: Two years later. Daemon and the Sea Snake battle the Crabfeeder. The realm celebrates Aegon's second nameday. Rhaenyra faces the prospect of marriage.

episodes.name: King of the Narrow Sea
episodes.overview: Rhaenyra continues her search for a suitable match, Daemon returns to Kings Landing and stirs more trouble for the King. Rhaenyra learns a valuable lesson about desires and what it means to be a daughter of a King.

episodes.name: We Light the Way
episodes.overview: Daemon visits his wife in the Vale. Viserys and Rhaenyra broker agreements with the Velaryons. Alicent seeks the truth about the princess.

episodes.name: The Princess and the Queen
episodes.overview: Ten years after the wedding between Rhaenyra Targaryen and Laenor Velaryon, King Viserys survived his collapse and has now fathered 3 children with Alicent Hightower. Rhaenyra navigates Alicent's continued speculation about her parentage of children, while Daemon and Laena weigh an offer in Pentos.

episodes.name: Driftmark
episodes.overview: As the families gather on Driftmark for a funeral, Viserys calls for an end to infighting and Alicent demands justice.

episodes.name: The Lord of the Tides
episodes.overview: Six years later. With the Driftmark succession suddenly critical, Rhaenyra attempts to strike a bargain with Rhaenys.

episodes.name: The Green Council
episodes.overview: While Alicent enlists Cole and Aemond to track down Aegon, she plots a heavy political drama in Kings Landing to crown her first-born son. Amidst all the obstacles, the hand, the queen and their allies successfully names Aegon II to be the next king. Otto gathers the great houses of Westeros to affirm their allegiance.

episodes.name: The Black Queen
episodes.overview: While mourning a tragic loss, Rhaenyra tries to hold the realm together, and Daemon prepares for war.

episodes.name: A Son for a Son
episodes.overview: While Rhaenyra struggles to come to terms with her son's murder, in King's Landing, Alicent grows concerned that Aegon's Small Council may lead them to an all-out war. Larys suggests Aegon needs a new Hand, and Rhaenyra arrives at a fateful decision.

episodes.name: Rhaenyra the Cruel
episodes.overview: As Otto schemes to turn the public against her, Rhaenyra questions Daemon's loyalty. Meanwhile, Ser Criston Cole concocts a misguided plan for revenge.

episodes.name: The Burning Mill
episodes.overview: As ancient grudges resurface, Rhaenys suggests that Alicent may see reason while the men around her seek bloodshed. Ser Criston proposes a bold scheme. Daemon arrives at Harrenhal to raise an army for the Blacks.

episodes.name: The Red Dragon and the Gold
episodes.overview: In Rhaenyra's absence and with no word from Daemon at Harrenhal, Rhaenys tries to keep the peace on the Black Council as Cole mounts a campaign into the Crownlands. In King's Landing, Aemond continues to undermine Aegon's fragile hold on authority.

episodes.name: Regent
episodes.overview: Amid whispers of bad omens, the Greens consider how to fill a void on Aegon's Council, Jacaerys sets out on a rogue mission to strike a deal, and Daemon enlists Lord Willem Blackwood to help persuade the Brackens to bend the knee.

episodes.name: Smallfolk
episodes.overview: With few options left, Rhaenyra summons a trusted knight for a risky venture and plots with Mysaria to catalyze the smallfolk. Meanwhile, Daemon's unease grows, and Aemond takes steps to reshape the Green Council.

episodes.name: The Red Sowing
episodes.overview: As Rhaenyra looks to gain an advantage by unusual means, Daemon pressures a young liege lord to raise up his bannermen.

episodes.name: The Queen Who Ever Was
episodes.overview: As Aemond becomes more volatile, Larys plots an escape, and Alicent grows more concerned about Helaena's safety. Flush with new power, Rhaenyra looks to press her advantage.

episodes.name: Salt and Sea, Fire and Blood
episodes.overview: Driven by her faith in Alicent, Rhaenyra positions herself to take King's Landing while the Triarchy sails to take on Corlys in the Gullet.

episodes.name: Queen's Landing
episodes.overview: As Alicent risks everything to fulfill her end of the bargain, Rhaenyra must decide whether the Iron Throne is worth the cost.

episodes.name: Rhaenyra Triumphant
episodes.overview: Rhaenyra learns the situation in King's Landing is not what she anticipated. Unable to locate her enemies, and with demands coming from all sides, Rhaenyra must navigate a delicate balance between appeasing her supporters and consolidating her rule.

episodes.name: Tumbleton
episodes.overview: Ormund's invasion of Tumbleton forces Rhaenyra into a corner.

episodes.name: Unbowed and Unbent
episodes.overview: As the search for Aemond and Vhagar continues, Daemon attempts to control the spiraling situation in King's Landing.

episodes.name: Faceless Men
episodes.overview: While Rhaenyra and Daemon focus on how best to deal with Ormund, tensions among their neglected allies begin to erupt.

episodes.name: The Dragon in Winter
episodes.overview: Torn between Mysaria and Daemon's visions for her reign, Rhaenyra grows desperate for a sign that she will prevail.

episodes.name: The Treasons at Tumbleton
episodes.overview: Shifting alliances irrevocably reshape the war as Rhaenyra's forces converge around Tumbleton and both sides vie to gain the upper hand.

name: Lupin
overview: Inspired by the adventures of Arsène Lupin, gentleman thief Assane Diop sets out to avenge his father for an injustice inflicted by a wealthy family.

episodes.name: Chapitre 1
episodes.overview: Years after a tragic injustice, Assane seeks to settle a score — and a debt — by stealing a diamond necklace, but the heist takes an unexpected turn.

episodes.name: Chapitre 2
episodes.overview: Assane hatches a plot to contact Comet, an inmate who steers him to a clue about Babakar's demise. Anne Pellegrini comes clean about the past.

episodes.name: Chapitre 3
episodes.overview: Assane confronts Commissioner Dumont and plants a decoy to divert the police. Hubert Pellegrini's connection to Babakar's fate comes to light.

episodes.name: Chapitre 4
episodes.overview: To retrieve incriminating evidence on Hubert, Assane enlists the help of a journalist. Officer Guédira connects the dots around the Louvre heist.

episodes.name: Chapitre 5
episodes.overview: En route to Étretat with Claire and Raoul, Assane encounters an unwelcome figure. In a bind, Assane sends a message to Capt. Laugier.

episodes.name: Chapitre 6
episodes.overview: Assane searches for Raoul with Guédira in tow. In a deserted Normandy mansion, a heated confrontation erupts between Leonard and Assane.

episodes.name: Chapitre 7
episodes.overview: Hubert makes a deal with Dumont and sets a trap for Assane, who's one step ahead. Claire knocks on Hubert's door.

episodes.name: Chapitre 8
episodes.overview: As he attempts to gain Juliette's trust with a series of capers, Assane devises an elaborate plot that would blindside Hubert.

episodes.name: Chapitre 9
episodes.overview: Leonard tails Assane to his home. Hubert orchestrates a frame-up. Assane leaves a clue online for Guédira that sheds light on Dumont.

episodes.name: Chapitre 10
episodes.overview: In a scheme to usurp all schemes, Assane and Benjamin recruit and disguise a clever accomplice in order to bring Hubert to justice.

episodes.name: Chapitre 1
episodes.overview: To mend matters with Claire and Raoul, Assane devises a plan to get them out of France. But with high stakes come greater risks — and no room for error.

episodes.name: Chapitre 2
episodes.overview: An unfathomable loss rocks France, but Guédira and Raoul grapple with denial. A mysterious classified ad resurrects old ghosts and long-lost hopes.

episodes.name: Chapitre 3
episodes.overview: As Fleur and Guédira strike a deal, Belkacem visits Benjamin. Assane tries to outmaneuver a new enemy in the shadows while keeping tabs on his family.

episodes.name: Chapitre 4
episodes.overview: Assane meets his mother's captor in the flesh, but there's no sign of her. Tasked with another all-or-nothing heist, he makes a devastating choice.

episodes.name: Chapitre 5
episodes.overview: Increasingly suspicious, Claire launches an investigation of her own. Guédira gets the surprise — and opportunity — of a literature lover's lifetime.

episodes.name: Chapitre 6
episodes.overview: Having identified his opponent, Assane races to protect his family and avoid retaliation. Belkacem remains wary of Guédira; Mariama sends a message.

episodes.name: Chapitre 7
episodes.overview: A family reunion years in the making comes to pass. With Mariama's help, Assane makes a final play to stop Keller, right his wrongs and go out in style.

episodes.name: Chapitre 1
episodes.overview: After four years in prison, Assane is days away from early release and a new life with Raoul – until a mysterious cyberattack threatens it all.

episodes.name: Chapitre 2
episodes.overview: A furious Guédira vows to take Lupin down as Assane comes face to face with his copycat, whose high-risk offer lures him to a heist at the Eiffel Tower.

episodes.name: Chapitre 3
episodes.overview: Assane proclaims his innocence as Raoul lands in his own set of troubles, forcing his dad to join forces with unexpected allies to capture the copycat.

episodes.name: Chapitre 4
episodes.overview: As police prepare to take Adèle back to London, Raoul's long-awaited trip with his dad hits a last-minute snag. Ben and Assane concoct a daring scheme.

episodes.name: Chapitre 5
episodes.overview: Vowing to go after the Guardians of the Treasure, Adèle and Assane set their sights on Les Invalides. Meanwhile, Raoul also puts his skills to use.

episodes.name: Chapitre 6
episodes.overview: Assane awakes to an ominous figure from his past. Compelled to tell the truth, he hatches a death-defying plan. Esteban finds Raoul's new place of work.

episodes.name: Chapitre 7
episodes.overview: As Raoul embarks on his own journey, Assane and Adèle retrace old steps with new technology to find the treasure – with Korvin hot on their trail.

episodes.name: Chapitre 8
episodes.overview: Assane and the gang attempt to lure the treasure out of the fortress. But can they outrun the police, the Guardians and all the chaos they've caused?

name: Bridgerton
overview: Wealth, lust, and betrayal set in the backdrop of Regency era England, seen through the eyes of the powerful Bridgerton family.

episodes.name: Diamond of the First Water
episodes.overview: Daphne debuts on London's marriage market as a new gossip sheet sets high society atwitter and Simon, the eligible Duke of Hastings, returns to town.

episodes.name: Shock and Delight
episodes.overview: Simon's apparent courtship of Daphne angers her brother Anthony and threatens to ruin the arrangements he made. Marina opens up to a curious Penelope.

episodes.name: Art of the Swoon
episodes.overview: After Daphne catches the eye of a royal suitor, she turns to Simon for relationship advice. Lady Featherington tries to browbeat Marina into marriage.

episodes.name: An Affair of Honor
episodes.overview: Daphne receives a stunning gift from Prince Friedrich but soon courts scandal at a ball. Eloise searches for clues to Lady Whistledown's identity.

episodes.name: The Duke and I
episodes.overview: To fend off rumors about their garden escapade, Simon and Daphne must make a personal appeal to the queen. Marina's wedlock scheme dismays Penelope.

episodes.name: Swish
episodes.overview: On her honeymoon, Daphne discovers just how uninformed she is about the physical aspects of the marital bed. Colin comes to a decision about Marina.

episodes.name: Oceans Apart
episodes.overview: Amid accusations of lies and betrayal, a rift forms between the newlyweds, while a deception of another kind could besmirch the Bridgerton family name.

episodes.name: After the Rain
episodes.overview: The duke and duchess's season-ending ball signals a turning point for their marriage — and ushers in changes of fortune and fate to those around them.

episodes.name: Capital R Rake
episodes.overview: Anthony begins his search for a wife, Eloise braves her society debut, and Lady Danbury helps the queen choose a diamond among the season's debutantes.

episodes.name: Off to the Races
episodes.overview: Facing heated competition and a prickly foe, Anthony steps up his courtship game. Eloise makes a Lady Whistledown discovery as a family member returns.

episodes.name: A Bee in Your Bonnet
episodes.overview: The Sharmas arrive at the Bridgerton's country estate, where Anthony seeks to win Kate's good opinion amid bad memories and a ruthless game of pall-mall.

episodes.name: Victory
episodes.overview: As guests gather for the Bridgerton's ball, Anthony and Kate clash during a hunting party, Colin revisits the past, and Lady Featherington sets a trap.

episodes.name: An Unthinkable Fate
episodes.overview: Rattled by Anthony's hasty nuptial plans, Kate receives advice from Lady Danbury. Eloise spars with a new ally. Emotions run high during a dinner party.

episodes.name: The Choice
episodes.overview: Anthony's duty to his family wars with his desire for Kate. Edwina ponders her future — and impresses the queen. Eloise's rendezvous stirs suspicion.

episodes.name: Harmony
episodes.overview: Scandalous rumors swirl around the Bridgertons and the Sharmas. The queen's ire over Lady Whistledown lands Eloise and Penelope in a quandary.

episodes.name: The Viscount Who Loved Me
episodes.overview: Anthony lashes out as he awaits news of Kate, while Eloise turns to Theo for help in her Lady Whistledown hunt and Lady Featherington plans a grand ball.

episodes.name: Out of the Shadows
episodes.overview: The debutantes enter the marriage mart as Francesca navigates her first season out. A well-traveled bachelor returns, and Penelope unveils a new look.

episodes.name: How Bright the Moon
episodes.overview: Penelope begins her private lessons in charming suitors, but the arrangement quickly grows complicated. A dazzling debutante seizes the queen's attention.

episodes.name: Forces of Nature
episodes.overview: Penelope catches the eye of nature-loving Lord Debling, to the dismay of other admirers. A near-catastrophe on a windy day makes a hero out of Colin.

episodes.name: Old Friends
episodes.overview: When a caller arrives at her home, Penelope faces a difficult choice. For others, opportunities to build a fresh start — and find a love match — abound.

episodes.name: Tick Tock
episodes.overview: Lady Whistledown's surprising engagement announcement reverberates through the Ton, while Penelope grapples with the need to disclose her true identity.

episodes.name: Romancing Mister Bridgerton
episodes.overview: A desperate impostor strives to publicly win the queen's favor. Penelope races to write an urgent missive — but has the damage already been done?

episodes.name: Joining of Hands
episodes.overview: A shocking column fuels the queen's search for the real Lady Whistledown. As the wedding looms, Penelope questions her future as a wife — and scribe.

episodes.name: Into the Light
episodes.overview: With a rival threatening to divulge her secret for money, Penelope chooses the best path forward as her relationships and livelihood hang in the balance.

episodes.name: The Waltz
episodes.overview: Despite pressure from the ton, Benedict Bridgerton isn't one to settle down — until a masked woman at a ball unexpectedly captures his heart.

episodes.name: Time Transfixed
episodes.overview: To find his mystery woman, Benedict enlists the help of none other than Lady Whistledown. Lady Danbury's patience with the Queen wears decidedly thin.

episodes.name: The Field Next to the Other Road
episodes.overview: An unexpected detour draws Benedict and Sophie closer together. Back in Mayfair, the help gains the upper hand in a heated "maid war."

episodes.name: An Offer from a Gentleman
episodes.overview: Eager to focus on her new role, Sophie finds her longing for Benedict is hard to shake. Francesca broaches a sensitive topic. Violet hosts tea for two.

episodes.name: Yes or No
episodes.overview: A new neighbor shakes up Bridgerton House. Hyacinth and Gregory take their first steps into society. Penelope struggles with the loss of anonymity.

episodes.name: The Passing Winter
episodes.overview: Sophie fears the consequences of an impulsive decision. Benedict comes to terms with a new heir. A lavish ball is upended by a shocking announcement.

episodes.name: The Beyond
episodes.overview: The Bridgerton family unites in the wake of a tragedy. Sophie's plans hit a snag. Benedict faces a heartwrenching choice.

episodes.name: Dance in the Country
episodes.overview: With Sophie in peril and the entire family's reputation at stake, the Bridgertons must rely on the ton's most powerful currency: scandal.

name: Ozark
overview: A financial adviser drags his family from Chicago to the Missouri Ozarks, where he must launder $500 million in five years to appease a drug boss.

episodes.name: Sugarwood
episodes.overview: After his business partner cheats a dangerous client, financial adviser Marty must devise a radical plan to save the lives of himself and his family.

episodes.name: Blue Cat
episodes.overview: In the Ozarks, Marty struggles to find a local business he can use for money laundering, while his kids make new friends but neglect a crucial duty.

episodes.name: My Dripping Sleep
episodes.overview: Marty finds a way to control Ruth. Wendy worms her way into a job. Looking for another business to invest in, Marty digs for info on the strip bar.

episodes.name: Tonight We Improvise
episodes.overview: Marty hires Ruth to pull off a heist. Agent Petty forges a relationship with a member of the Langmore family. Jonah exhibits disturbing behavior.

episodes.name: Ruling Days
episodes.overview: Marty decides to invest in the religious sector, unaware he will disrupt a discreet business operation. A surprise visitor shows up at the Byrde home.

episodes.name: Book of Ruth
episodes.overview: Jacob educates Marty on his business. Ruth devises and sets in motion a deadly plan. Rachel learns Marty is cooking the books at the Blue Cat Lodge.

episodes.name: Nest Box
episodes.overview: To stop Jacob from carrying out his threat, Marty makes an offer. Agent Petty gets what he needs to turn Russ. Charlotte grows desperate to escape.

episodes.name: Kaleidoscope
episodes.overview: In a flashback to 10 years prior, Wendy struggles with depression, Del asks Marty to be his financial adviser, and Agent Petty faces a family crisis.

episodes.name: Coffee, Black
episodes.overview: Russ learns Agent Petty's true identity and makes plans to murder, steal and flee. Wendy stumbles on an ideal business to add to the Byrde portfolio.

episodes.name: The Toll
episodes.overview: During his next sermon, Mason falters. Wendy and the kids are caught trying to flee their home. Marty brokers a deal between Jacob and Del.

episodes.name: Reparations
episodes.overview: Ruth's dad gets out of jail. Approval for a riverboat casino calls for Wendy's political skills. The Mexican cartel demands reparations from the Snells.

episodes.name: The Precious Blood of Jesus
episodes.overview: When a mobster jeopardizes the casino bill, Marty enlists Buddy's help. Wendy resorts to dirty tactics to get votes. Cade reminds Ruth of her roots.

episodes.name: Once a Langmore...
episodes.overview: Wendy does damage control when Wilkes's pressure on Sen. Blake backfires. Rachel is sent on a mission. Ruth resists accepting her Langmore destiny.

episodes.name: Stag
episodes.overview: The FBI sends out a second lure. Charlotte slips up while chatting with Wyatt. The Byrdes grow wary of Rachel, who deflects suspicion onto someone else.

episodes.name: Game Day
episodes.overview: Agent Petty's revelation tests the loyalties of Marty, Ruth and the cartel. Despite the FBI closing in, the Snells refuse to destroy their poppies.

episodes.name: Outer Darkness
episodes.overview: An FBI search of the Snells' field yields a surprise. Playing hardball, Agent Petty questions Wilkes. The Byrdes mourn a loss.

episodes.name: One Way Out
episodes.overview: Mason goes off the deep end and focuses his rage on the Byrdes. Ruth tries to make her dad proud during a boat-part heist.

episodes.name: The Big Sleep
episodes.overview: Darlene makes one too many rash moves. Marty tries to free Rachel from Agent Petty's grasp. Jonah helps his mom force Wilkes to continue his support.

episodes.name: The Badger
episodes.overview: Marty finds a way around the Snells. Charlotte hires a lawyer. The Byrdes get a meeting with the gaming commission, whose approval comes with a big ask.

episodes.name: The Gold Coast
episodes.overview: Marty makes plans without telling Wendy. Darlene sends a message via Jonah. Wyatt learns the truth about his dad. Ruth realizes Cade must be stopped.

episodes.name: Wartime
episodes.overview: Marty is pressured to move money ahead of schedule, Wendy pitches a high-stakes plan, Wyatt lives the good life, and Ruth butts heads in the casino.

episodes.name: Civil Union
episodes.overview: Wendy asks Helen — not Marty — to help close a deal, the Byrdes get a new houseguest, and business goes boom aboard a rival casino.

episodes.name: Kevin Cronin Was Here
episodes.overview: The FBI dives into the casino's finances, Wendy's dreams take a dark turn, and Marty worries that the writing may be on the wall.

episodes.name: Boss Fight
episodes.overview: As Wendy, Helen and Ruth strive to keep the business humming, Navarro plays mind games with Marty, who worries he'll never see his family again.

episodes.name: It Came from Michoacán
episodes.overview: Maya steps up her bid to turn Marty, whose eerily calm demeanor has Wendy worried. The Byrdes buy a horse farm on behalf of Navarro.

episodes.name: Su Casa Es Mi Casa
episodes.overview: Marty and Wendy tell each other how they really feel, Ruth confronts Wyatt, Darlene lets her ambitions be known, and Ben's past comes into focus.

episodes.name: In Case of Emergency
episodes.overview: The FBI questions Ruth, tensions between Cosgrove and Marty hit a new high, Sue takes on a new patient, and Wendy recruits for her foundation.

episodes.name: BFF
episodes.overview: Ruth isn't happy about Marty and Wendy's plan to bury the hatchet with Frank Jr. The Byrdes make a difficult decision about Ben. Maya is reprimanded.

episodes.name: Fire Pink
episodes.overview: Ben's confrontation with Helen and Erin sends the Byrdes into crisis mode. Meanwhile, Sam's concerns about the FBI inspire little sympathy.

episodes.name: All In
episodes.overview: While Wendy battles personal demons, Marty struggles to keep their lives from falling apart. Darlene does Ruth a favor.

episodes.name: The Beginning of the End
episodes.overview: Marty and Wendy wrestle with a problematic offer. Ruth goes out on her own, Jonah rebels, and Omar's nephew makes his presence known.

episodes.name: Let The Great World Spin
episodes.overview: Maya pushes back on Marty's plan for Omar. Ruth pursues the hipster heroin market. Wendy tries to raise $150 million. The new sheriff causes problems.

episodes.name: City On The Make
episodes.overview: Maya and Omar meet face-to-face. Wendy has a contentious business meeting. Ruth goes behind Darlene's back. Jonah finds a new place to set up shop.

episodes.name: Ace Deuce
episodes.overview: Wendy's claims about Ben anger Ruth. Mel the P.I. tracks down Wendy's father. Ruth's trip to the Missouri Belle with Kerry doesn't go as planned.

episodes.name: Ellie
episodes.overview: The Senator extends an olive branch — with a twist. Ruth and Marty scramble to rebuy the drugs Darlene sold. Charlotte ponders life after high school.

episodes.name: Sangre Sobre Todo
episodes.overview: Marty is tasked with proving Omar wasn't involved with a bombing. Wendy pays a visit to the Lazy-O Motel. Ruth and Wyatt make a plan.

episodes.name: Sanctified
episodes.overview: The FBI's long-awaited meeting with Omar takes place. Wyatt shares some news with Ruth. Feeling betrayed, Javi gets aggressive.

episodes.name: The Cousin of Death
episodes.overview: Devastated by a tremendous loss, Ruth heads to Chicago to enact revenge as Marty tries to talk her out of doing something she may regret.

episodes.name: Pick a God and Pray
episodes.overview: Their deal with the FBI now dead, the Byrdes desperately search for more solutions to their growing problems. Wendy's father comes to town.

episodes.name: You're the Boss
episodes.overview: Marty travels to the Navarro estate, Ruth asks Frank Jr. for a favor, a new acting sheriff makes waves, and Wendy tries to bring Jim back into the fold.

episodes.name: Pound of Flesh and Still Kickin'
episodes.overview: Ruth makes a play for the casino with some help from a familiar face. Wendy cozies up to Omar's sister and arranges a meeting with Clare.

episodes.name: Trouble The Water
episodes.overview: Nathan angers Wendy by making Charlotte and Jonah a surprising offer. Ruth tries to erase her own past with an assist from Charles Wilkes.

episodes.name: Mud
episodes.overview: Omar pressures Marty to launder more money, but Ruth wants to keep her casino clean. Wendy goes to extremes to keep her children.

episodes.name: A Hard Way to Go
episodes.overview: Every desperate deal. Every broken promise. Every bloody murder. Eager to leave their murky past behind, the Byrdes make a final bid for freedom.

name: MINDHUNTER
overview: An agent in the FBI's Elite Serial Crime Unit develops profiling techniques as he pursues notorious serial killers and rapists.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: In 1977, frustrated FBI hostage negotiator Holden Ford finds an unlikely ally in veteran agent Bill Tench and begins studying a new class of murderer.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Holden interviews the eerily articulate murderer Ed Kemper, but his research provokes negative feedback at the Bureau.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Dr. Wendy Carr joins Holden and Tench in their first success, when their insights lead to an arrest.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Bill and Holden consult with Dr. Wendy Carr to begin classifying their subjects. They receive surprising news.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Holden and Bill return to a perplexing case in Pennsylvania where a set of clues leading in multiple directions leaves no shortage of suspects.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Wendy considers an offer. Holden and Bill struggle to communicate the meaning of their findings to the judicial system in the baffling Altoona case.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Wendy takes a career risk to relocate and join the team full time. Holden and Bill find it harder to keep the emotional intensity of work at bay.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Bill and Wendy interview candidates for a fourth member of the team. Holden is intrigued by complaints about a school principal's odd habit.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: Holden's methods during a disturbing interview with mass murderer Richard Speck create dissension among the team and kick off an internal FBI probe.

episodes.name: Episode 10
episodes.overview: The team cracks under pressure from an in-house review. Holden's bold style elicits a confession but puts his career, relationships and health at risk.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Amid sweeping changes at the BSU, Holden deals with severe repercussions from his close encounter with Ed Kemper.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: To glean insight into the elusive BTK killer, Bill and Holden interview the Son of Sam, who makes a startling admission.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Bill gets drawn into a horrifying crime that hits close to home. Holden receives an intriguing offer while in Atlanta to interview a pair of killers.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Holden develops a controversial profile in the Atlanta slayings. Wendy conducts her first interview and finds being on the front lines suits her well.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Bill's devastating family situation spills over during his interview with Holden's holy-grail subject: Charles Manson. Wendy's new romance heats up.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The FBI officially sends the BSU to Atlanta to investigate the missing and murdered children. Wendy second-guesses her interview methods.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Hitting a dead end, Holden suggests a bold plan to draw the killer out. Bill's family faces more scrutiny. Wendy chafes as her job begins to shift.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Red tape hinders Holden's plan to narrow his suspect pool. A weary and heartsick Bill tries to connect with his son. Wendy rethinks her relationship.

episodes.name: Episode 9
episodes.overview: The investigation zeroes in on a prime suspect who proves surprisingly adept at manipulating a volatile situation to his advantage.

name: Sex Education
overview: Inexperienced Otis channels his sex therapist mom when he teams up with rebellious Maeve to set up an underground sex therapy clinic at school.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Despite the ministrations of sex therapist mom Jean and encouragement from pal Eric, Otis worries that he can't get it on. He's not the only one.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Egged on by Maeve -- and finding that dispensing sex tips is tougher than he thought -- Otis tries offering free advice at a classmate's house party.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Otis' clinic achieves liftoff, as does his attraction to Maeve, who unexpectedly asks him for help. Eric swings off on his own and fields a come-on.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Eric realizes Otis has fallen for Maeve. But the young sex therapist finds himself torn when hot guy Jackson seeks help with his secret crush.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: An explicit pic puts a mean girl on the spot. Maeve wants to track down the shaming culprit, forcing Otis to make a tough choice on an important day.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Eric's trauma isolates him, and Maeve's essay wins a prize. Otis tries to hook up with Lily, but his deep-seated issues get in the way.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: The big dance brings out the best, and the drama, in Moordale's student body. Otis finds a date, Maeve gets her dress, and Eric returns with style.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Otis feels violated by Jean's new book, and Maeve takes the fall for her brother. Eric serves detention with an old foe, while Lily's body betrays her.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Masturbation turns out to be Otis's secret talent, but can he master his unruly desires for Ola? A chlamydia outbreak distracts the student body.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: After Jean makes a cringey appearance at school, Otis tries his hand at pleasing Ola -- and advising a hapless teacher. Fearless Maeve buckles.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: On her way to surprise Maeve, Aimee gets a horrible shock on the bus. Rahim connects with Eric as a Milburn family dinner gets seriously awkward.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Ola wants to go all the way, but Otis is on edge. Jean and Maeve need their space. Jackson has performance worries, and star-crossed lovers reconnect.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Otis and Eric get away from romance and retreat to the woods with Remi. But parents aren't perfect, as Maeve knows. Later, Ola follows her heart.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Bouncing back is the only option, so Otis throws a small gathering that turns rowdy, and Jackson deals with the healing. Who can handle the truth?

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Welcome to the morning after. "Sex kid" has made a huge mess -- and just can't stop barfing. Chaos comes to class, and in detention, the girls bond.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: The talking cure may be failing Otis and Jean as they sort out their issues. A wary Maeve makes the finals. Sexy Shakespeare never goes out of style.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Moordale's friskiest come together again — in more ways than one. Otis sports a 'stache but hides a secret. Jean comes clean. A head teacher arrives.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: Makeovers take over when Ruby gives Otis a magnetic revamp and Hope tones the school down. Way down. Elsewhere, Eric and Adam look to level up.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: Self-expression is out as uniforms sweep the student body. Aimee opens up about the assault while Jackson bonds with cool nonbinary student Cal.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: In the cold light of day, can sex turn into intimacy, and vice versa? Ruby recoils from Otis. Maeve connects with Isaac. Abstinence roils Moordale.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Vivid history collides with real awkwardness in France as the poo hits a windshield and friends slam on the brakes. A spark reignites. Jean explodes.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: The truth is out there: Maeve gets the news, Aimee reveals her vulva cupcakes and more, and Eric navigates Nigerian life. Hope goes to new extremes.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Home is where the heat is. Jean contends with a hot mess and a cold shoulder. Maeve deals with a mum on the run. The "sex school" finally goes public.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: As a new day dawns, Moordale's fate hangs in the balance. Aimee spills. Eric confesses. Otis haunts the hospital. Honesty matters now, more than ever.

episodes.name: Episode 1
episodes.overview: Maeve butts heads with a prickly professor. Oceans apart, will her connection with Otis sizzle or fizzle? An attempted nude leads to a hairy situation.

episodes.name: Episode 2
episodes.overview: When a popular couple is on the rocks, Otis eyes an opportunity. Eric finds community. Surprises in the bedroom leave Jackson questioning his sexuality.

episodes.name: Episode 3
episodes.overview: A scathing review rattles Maeve's resolve. Adam and Michael bond over life as a bachelor. Ruby helps Otis with his campaign — and his loneliness.

episodes.name: Episode 4
episodes.overview: Tragedy brings a familiar face back to Moordale. Jean's saving grace is Otis' worst nightmare. Ruby does recon. Aisha asks out Cal — but there's a twist.

episodes.name: Episode 5
episodes.overview: Jean struggles to find joy in motherhood. Between heated debates and a hot date with a grieving Maeve, can Otis perform? Jackson has an identity crisis.

episodes.name: Episode 6
episodes.overview: Goodbyes are never easy, but this one's a mess. With emotions firing on all cylinders, Maeve finds the right words. Aimee gets inspired; Eric gets real.

episodes.name: Episode 7
episodes.overview: Elevator inaction sparks collective action. A sisterly argument years in the making finally boils over. Maeve makes things right — and makes a choice.

episodes.name: Episode 8
episodes.overview: Cavendish rallies to search for Cal. As Eric finds his calling, Jackson discovers his roots. Much like love, truth takes many forms — and it will out.

name: The Umbrella Academy
overview: Reunited by their father's death, estranged siblings with extraordinary powers uncover shocking family secrets — and a looming threat to humanity.

episodes.name: We Only See Each Other at Weddings and Funerals
episodes.overview: Years after they rose to fame as young crime-fighting superheroes, the estranged Hargreeves siblings come together to mark their father's death.

episodes.name: Run Boy Run
episodes.overview: After sharing the story of his time travel with Vanya, Five hunts for the owner of a fake eye. But two mysterious assassins are hot on his trail.

episodes.name: Extra Ordinary
episodes.overview: Worried their mother is hiding something, Luther and Allison call a family meeting. Cha-Cha and Hazel catch a big break in their hunt for Five.

episodes.name: Man on the Moon
episodes.overview: The story of Luther's transformation emerges. At the motel, Klaus puts Hazel and Cha-Cha's training to the test. Allison grows suspicious of Leonard.

episodes.name: Number Five
episodes.overview: Five lets Luther in on his secret, Klaus returns from a harrowing trip through time, and Vanya begins to feel different without her meds.

episodes.name: The Day That Wasn't
episodes.overview: Sparks fly when Vanya finds her siblings holding an emergency family meeting without her. Five starts his new job at HQ. Cha-Cha faces a dilemma.

episodes.name: The Day That Was
episodes.overview: With a second chance at the day, the siblings team up to find the mysterious "Harold Jenkins." Leonard takes Vanya into the woods to test her powers.

episodes.name: I Heard a Rumor
episodes.overview: As Vanya practices controlling her new abilities, Allison tags along with a local cop to find out what happened outside the restaurant.

episodes.name: Changes
episodes.overview: Vanya veers between shock and despair as she makes a string of unsettling discoveries. A serendipitous development leaves Five at loose ends.

episodes.name: The White Violin
episodes.overview: As a lifetime of secrets and resentment bring the Umbrella Academy crashing down, the Hargreeves siblings realize the worst is still to come.

episodes.name: Right Back Where We Started
episodes.overview: After dropping his siblings into an alley in Dallas — in different years — Five scrambles to track them all down and stop a new doomsday threat.

episodes.name: The Frankel Footage
episodes.overview: An incident at the bar leads Luther to Vanya. Five finds an unsettling surprise in the film Hazel left behind. The cops come after Allison's husband.

episodes.name: The Swedish Job
episodes.overview: As the sit-in approaches, Allison reconnects with Klaus, the Swedes chase Vanya into a cornfield, and Luther makes a distressing discovery.

episodes.name: The Majestic 12
episodes.overview: While Allison searches frantically for Ray, Vanya contends with a crisis at the farm, and Five, Diego and Lila crash a party at the Mexican Consulate.

episodes.name: Valhalla
episodes.overview: Summoned to an emergency meeting, the siblings hatch very different plans for how to spend their last six days on Earth. Lila confronts her mother.

episodes.name: A Light Supper
episodes.overview: Allison gives Ray a peek at her powers, Dave visits Klaus's compound, the Handler offers Five a deal, and the siblings meet their father for dinner.

episodes.name: Öga for Öga
episodes.overview: After Five travels to 1982 to carry out his new mission, the siblings face a flurry of difficult decisions. Carl issues a warning to Vanya.

episodes.name: The Seven Stages
episodes.overview: A desperate Five concocts a risky plan to intercept another version of himself. The FBI tortures Vanya. Diego discovers what causes the apocalypse.
As the Fives plot against each other, one of the siblings makes a big sacrifice to help Vanya, and Lila learns the truth about her parents.

episodes.name: The End of Something
episodes.overview: Reeling from the events at Dealey Plaza, the siblings head to the farm to help save Harlan — only to find themselves drawn into a deadly showdown.

episodes.name: Meet the Family
episodes.overview: After averting a doomsday in Dallas, the Umbrella siblings return to a very different Academy — now ruled by the powerful and hostile Sparrows.

episodes.name: World's Biggest Ball of Twine
episodes.overview: With their Number One missing, the Sparrows take a hostage. Allison makes a painful discovery. Klaus takes Five on an eye-opening road trip.

episodes.name: Pocket Full of Lightning
episodes.overview: As people start disappearing in waves, Five and Lila reluctantly team up to solve their time-travel problem. Klaus sees a new side of his father.

episodes.name: Kugelblitz
episodes.overview: Luther and Sloane hatch a plan to end the war between the families. Viktor reconnects with someone from the past. Five has an unsettling encounter.

episodes.name: Kindest Cut
episodes.overview: Klaus's relationship with death proves more complicated than anyone knew. Viktor finally learns what happened to the Umbrellas' mothers.

episodes.name: Marigold
episodes.overview: Five chases down Pogo, Viktor and Harlan attempt a transfer of powers, and Diego and Lila venture beyond the wall of the White Buffalo Suite.

episodes.name: Auf Wiedersehen
episodes.overview: In 1989, Lila digs up one of her mother's secrets. The families join forces to fight the Kugelblitz. Reginald teaches Klaus to harness his powers.

episodes.name: Wedding at the End of the World
episodes.overview: With the universe collapsing around them, the gang gathers for a day of romance, awkwardness and debauchery at the Hotel Obsidian.

episodes.name: Seven Bells
episodes.overview: Reginald goes all out to convince the children to sign on to his plan. Five tries to recover a drunken memory. Allison has a change of heart.

episodes.name: Oblivion
episodes.overview: Shaken, the family confronts the deadly mysteries of the Hotel Oblivion — and the growing suspicion that their mission is not what it seems.

episodes.name: The Unbearable Tragedy of Getting What You Want
episodes.overview: The family teams up to find a kidnapped Viktor while attempting to adjust to normal life. Lila and Five probe a mysterious group called the Keepers.

episodes.name: Jean and Gene
episodes.overview: With their powers restored, the gang embarks on a mission to find Sy Grossman's daughter. But they soon encounter hostility in a seemingly quaint town.

episodes.name: The Squid and the Girl
episodes.overview: The group splits up to find Jennifer. Later on, they pay Reginald a visit, confronting memories that hold critical clues to their mission.

episodes.name: The Cleanse
episodes.overview: After learning the truth about Jennifer, the crew sets out to find her and Ben. Klaus hustles to escape his plight. Five and Lila try to change the past.

episodes.name: Six Years, Five Months, and Two Days
episodes.overview: Lila and Five get lost traversing various timelines. Meanwhile, Viktor and Reginald aim to stop Ben, whose union with Jennifer sets forth a lethal path.

episodes.name: End of the Beginning
episodes.overview: With Ben and Jennifer in peril and the Cleanse underway, the family unites for one last fight to save the world — and end the infinite devastation.
